method: Physically opened each20 final capture PNGs at original detail and4 source PNGs with view_image; reviewed layout,text,illustrations and action visibility at each size. Only this report written; no Unity/product/image changes.
scope: Scenes22settings,23help,24empty,28leave in5sizes. Scene23 is HELP in canonical manifest, not a library screen.
limitations: Static visual review; button functionality and input tests are separate evidence.
Common notebook style retained with extra application controls and responsive adaptation; no100percent fidelity claim.
